message.content:
**Gene Variant:** rs7412  
**Location & Gene:** Chromosome 19p13.32 – *APOE* (apolipoprotein E)  

| Population | Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) |
|------------|------------------------------|
| **European ancestry (overall)** | ≈ 7%–9% |
| **Northern Europe** | ≈ 8%–11% |
| **Southern/Western Europe** | ≈ 5%–8% |

> **Interpretation**  
> - The “minor” allele at this SNP is typically the **C‑allele**, which defines the ε² haplotype when combined with the complementary allele at rs429358.  
> - Frequencies above reflect aggregated data from major public repositories such as **gnomAD v3.1** and the **1000 Genomes Project Phase 3**. Exact numbers vary slightly between datasets due to sample size differences and regional stratification within continental populations.

### Sources

1. **gnomAD Browser (v3.1)** – Aggregated exome/genome sequencing data (~140k individuals); MAF for rs7412 in non-Finnish European cohort reported around 0.08.  
   <https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/>
2. **dbSNP / ClinVar** – Provides reference allele counts derived largely from gnomAD and other studies.  
   <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/snp/>

These figures represent current consensus estimates; individual studies may report slight deviations owing to specific sampling frames or genotyping platforms.
